svg.title: Two data structures, wired together
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Two data structures, wired together” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch showing a hash map of four keys each pointing at a node, labelled as answering where but not when; the same four nodes drawn as a doubly linked list from head to tail labelled as answering when but not where, with a singly linked version crossed out; then both wired together for a get of key C, with numbered strokes following the map pointer to the node, unlinking it by joining its two neighbours and splicing it in at the head in three pointer writes; and an eviction where the tail node is crossed out of both the list and the map, annotated with measured costs of 211 nanoseconds per operation and an 84.4 percent hit rate.
svg.text: draw it from memory, then compare
